defaults_call.message: the imagename parameter must be a path that exists ('' does not exist)

raises.value: ValueError("When mode='coords', start and end must both be specified.")
ValueError("When mode='length', center, length, and pa must all be specified.")
RuntimeError('Cannot create image analysis tool using %s' % imagename)

parameters.description: Output image name. If empty, no image is written.
parameters.name: outfile

parameters.description: If "coords", use start and end values. If "length", use center, length, and pa values.
parameters.name: mode

parameters.description: The starting pixel in the direction plane (array of two values).
parameters.name: start

parameters.description: The ending pixel in the direction plane (array of two values).
parameters.name: end

parameters.description: The center point in the direction plane (array of two values). If specified, length and pa must also be specified and neither of start nor end may be specified.
parameters.name: center

parameters.description: The length of the segment in the direction plane. If specified, center and pa must also be specified and neither of start nor end may be specified.
parameters.name: length

parameters.description: The position angle of the segment in the direction plane, measured from north through east. If specified, center and length must also be specified and neither of start nor end may be specified.
parameters.name: pa

parameters.description: Width of slice for averaging pixels perpendicular to the slice. Must be an odd positive integer or valid quantity. See help for details.
parameters.name: width

parameters.description: Unit for the offset axis in the resulting image. Must be a unit of angular measure.
parameters.name: unit

parameters.description: Overwrite the output if it exists?
parameters.name: overwrite

parameters.description: Region selection. Default is entire image. No selection is permitted in the direction plane.
parameters.name: region

parameters.description: Channels to use. Channels must be contiguous. Default is to use all channels.
parameters.name: chans

parameters.description: Stokes planes to use. Planes must be contiguous. Default is to use all stokes.
parameters.name: stokes

parameters.description: Mask to use. Default is none.
parameters.name: mask

parameters.description: Stretch the mask if necessary and possible? Default False
parameters.name: stretch
